purpose: The ventures Aidit OS works on. Read by the ops side, not only displayed — config/skill-matrix.json spent weeks being read by nothing but the cockpit, and a registry nobody reads is documentation wearing a config's clothes. A venture absent from this file is not worked on; `status` is what decides, never the presence of a directory under ventures/.
rules: tujuan is QUOTED from a source, never summarised into an agent's own words. An invented goal would steer every piece of work that follows it.
metrik stays null until the owner states one. A number an agent chose for him would make his system optimise for something he never asked for.
hardStops are boundaries somebody already wrote down, each with the line it came from. They are limits, not advice.
owner_decision_required lists what is ALWAYS his in this venture, regardless of how reversible it looks.

ventures.tujuan: Safety-first operating system for a future automated trading platform.
ventures.tujuan_sumber: ventures/caveman-trading-os/README.md, first line under the title
ventures.metrik_status: BELUM DINYATAKAN PEMILIK — the README states a phase, not a measure. Left empty on purpose; see the decision raised on 2026-09-04.
hardStops: No production trading code, broker credentials, order-submission logic, or live endpoints — the repository's own Phase 1 statement (README.md).
The broker is authoritative for live orders, fills and positions; nothing here may present itself as that authority (README.md, 'Source of truth').
Supabase holds operational metadata only and is never a hot-path execution dependency (README.md, 'Source of truth').
owner_decision_required: Anything that touches real money, position sizing, or risk limits.
Moving out of Phase 1 — that is, adding any live endpoint, broker credential, or order submission.
The five uncommitted local files, which have been waiting on him since KOL-66.

observed.note: It has an off-machine remote. Aidit OS itself does not — see the decision raised on 2026-09-04.

ventures.tujuan: SJS SuperApps is the operational ERP for SJS. This repository is the source of truth for the frontend, Supabase schema, Edge Functions, and system documentation.
ventures.metrik_status: BELUM DINYATAKAN PEMILIK — the README describes scope, not a measure of progress. Left empty on purpose; see the decision raised on 2026-09-04.
hardStops: This repository is the source of truth for schema and Edge Functions; changes made anywhere else are drift, not work (README.md).

Buku Toko's current operational behaviour is owner-accepted reality and is NOT automatically the target architecture — 'imperfect' is never sufficient grounds to call something obsolete (decision-ledger D20).
Low-friction for the worker, but the system must still know WHO performed each activity (decision-ledger D28).
owner_decision_required: Anything that changes what a worker in the family business has to do differently.
Schema or auth changes that touch attribution of who performed an action.
Commission and KPI rules — the subject of KOL-67, still waiting on him.
